context.exploration_scope: Tested whether real provenance (S2/S3) composes into a coherent Goal->Evidence->Provenance->Decision->Outcome Decision Context, using only real fields, for all 4 production goals

problem: S2/S3 confirmed provenance EXISTS for all 4 production goals, but existence of provenance does not by itself prove it composes into a usable, linked Decision Context -- that had to be tested empirically, not assumed.

decision.decision_summary: Extracted Evidence/Decision/Outcome for all 4 goals: goal_ghibli_production_pipeline(complete=true), goal_production_runtime(complete=true), goal_semantic_quality(complete=true), goal_character_narrative_intelligence(complete=false). Empirically demonstrated a fully-real, fully-linked Decision Context for goal_ghibli_production_pipeline. Verdict: DECISION_CONTEXT_VERIFIED. Goal<->Capability<->Provenance<->Decision consistency: true. 0 new structure, 0 real modifications, 0 automatic executions.

action.action_summary: Extracted Goal->Evidence->Provenance->Decision->Outcome for all 4 production goals from real trace-chain and SSI-incorporation-chain fields; empirically demonstrated 1 complete real chain; verified consistency.

result.note: goal_ghibli_production_pipeline's Decision Context is real and fully linked: evidence_source=trace_chain.real_fix_record.verification_result.

cause.root_cause_summary: Provenance existing (S2/S3) and provenance composing into a usable Decision Context are two different claims -- the second required actually extracting and linking the fields, which this phase did empirically rather than assuming from the first.

lesson: Confirming a prerequisite exists (provenance) is not the same as confirming the thing built on top of it (a linked Decision Context) actually works -- each layer needs its own empirical test.
